concerns.text: The constitution requires a pinned `requirements.txt` (or `pyproject.toml`) under `code/` and the plan's Constitution Check cites it as evidence ('requirements.txt pins dependencies'), but NO task creates or verifies this file. Without it, T012's 'clean checkout' end-to-end run and the isolated-venv execution requirement cannot be satisfied. Add it to T001 or T012.

Plan task T018 (Simulated Null Generation, 'optional sanity check' preserving marginal shapes) has no corresponding task in tasks.md. If it is intentionally dropped, the tasks doc should say so; otherwise a diagnostic task or an explicit note is needed so implementers don't execute the wrong set (the plan's T-numbering already diverges from tasks.md's T001–T012).

The spec's TestResult entity lists 'Mann-Whitney U' as a test type, but no task implements it and the test_result contract enum is only t_test/anova. Either the tasks should note this entity attribute is out of scope, or the spec entity should be amended — currently a spec element exists with no covering task.

Plan modules `code/config.py`, `code/utils/statistical_tests.py`, `code/utils/logging_config.py`, and `code/tests/unit/test_statistical_tests.py` have no covering task. If intentionally consolidated into the T001–T012 file layout, state the mapping explicitly (the plan's file paths also differ from tasks' top-level `code/*.py` layout, e.g. `code/data/download_datasets.py` vs `code/download_datasets.py`).
